rule.statement: A plaintiff can prove their title in a rei vindicatio action with sufficient evidence.
rule.supporting_quote: He bought the land on 1st of June , 1996 by Deed 2806 from three persons , namely two brothers and a sister being the only surviving children of Kaluwa Dewage Punchi Nona who got the land by way of the Partition Deed No. 10886 dated 23rd June, 1962, which is 34 years prior to Deed 2806.
